Hello,
Thank you so much for your positive review of our veterinary clinic.
Providing a calming environment and high-quality care for your pet is our priority.
Thank you again for your trust.
Your veterinary team
Excellent clinic! The staff are very welcoming, attentive, and take the time to explain things thoroughly. I highly recommend them and thank you!

In addition to being a passionate and experienced professional, Dr. Muguet was able to support us with great dignity and compassion during our cat's final moments.

Our pet has never been in such good hands, and we wouldn't consider any other veterinarian for our future animals.

The other veterinarians at the practice, although we saw them less frequently, are just as professional and dedicated to their work.

Professional and friendly. They listened well and gave clear answers.
I recommend them.

Hello,
Your positive feedback means a lot to us.
Our dedicated team works tirelessly to ensure the well-being and good health of your animals.
Your support motivates us to continue providing quality care.

Your veterinary team

I've been taking my cat to the clinic in Toulouse since 2020. It's always a little stressful for us, but the entire team at the clinic, with their kindness and the high-quality care they provide, quickly puts you at ease. You can tell that everyone there truly loves animals :)
While passing through Lyon, my dog's problem was quickly addressed and I received good explanations and good advice.

Hello,
We are pleased to have been able to contribute positively to your pet's health.
Your positive feedback encourages us to maintain this level of excellence.
We remain at your disposal should you have any questions or future veterinary needs.

Your Veterinary Team
Appalling and unprofessional reception. Veterinarians constantly coming and going.

Esther Dreumont is a very attentive veterinarian who respects the animal's consent. She asks the right questions and gives good advice. This allows for a thorough consultation without stressing the animal.

I went there for my two cats and two dogs.

Hello,
Thank you so much for sharing your positive experience.
We are pleased that we were able to meet your pet's needs in the best possible way.
Your satisfaction is important to us, and we appreciate your recommendation.

Your Veterinary Team

I've been going to this clinic for a while now to buy food for my very sick diabetic cat.

I've always been greeted with kindness and care, and it's always been a very pleasant experience EXCEPT
twice by the same person
(She was there yesterday, Tuesday, August 12th).
This person is awful.

Not at all friendly, and she made it very clear that I was bothering her. Every word she said was malicious, delivered in an aggressive and humiliating tone.

I asked her for a bag, and she just threw it on the counter without even opening it.

The same thing happened the first time I dealt with her.

ALL the other people I've dealt with have been so kind, friendly, and welcoming that it's really a shame.
Needless to say, I'd love to have her schedule so I never have to see her again.

Though your clinic is great, it's still excellent.

The staff is very competent; it's increasingly rare to find people who prioritize animals over money. Thank you all.
The only slight drawback is the air conditioning.
5 stars is not enough to describe the professionalism and care we received. Outstanding!!! Thanks to Jacques and all his colleagues for their hard work.
Perfect.

I came this afternoon with my little Boubou and I want to thank the whole team for their warm welcome.

Dr. Le Monnier was incredibly kind to us. He took the time to explain everything to me with great patience and answered all my questions, which reassured me immensely.

Sixtine and Marie at reception are also lovely, always smiling and very welcoming.

A huge thank you to the entire team for your professionalism and kindness. Boubou and I will definitely be back! 🐶❤️
For me, the best veterinary service that loves animals and doesn't do it for the money... unlike some in the district!!!

Hello,
Your trust and positive feedback towards our team mean a great deal to us.

We are delighted that our care was beneficial for your pet.

We remain available to provide you with convenient service and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team
Excellent clinic; the vets and assistants are pleasant, available, and gentle with the animals. The advice provided and the answers to questions are of high quality.
Ms. Dreumont is very competent and gentle with timid little Chihuahuas.

A clinic I highly recommend, both for the quality of care offered and for the kindness and professionalism of the staff. The assistants are excellent and offer great advice; Dr. Muguet is incredibly kind, and his love for animals shines in his eyes.

He knows how to put them at ease, takes his time during each consultation (and he has a great sense of humor too).

You can go there with complete confidence; don't pay any attention to the opinions of frustrated, self-important people who think they're the center of the universe.
The whole team is very friendly and efficient

I highly recommend this practice. The assistants are friendly and helpful. I've been to this practice several times for my dog. We had a really tough time from December 2024 to January. My dog ​​had a swollen ear, which required multiple drainage and two surgeries (because he loves to roll around, he became depressed with the cone and socks on after the first surgery, so we removed the cone too soon). So, it was back to square one: drainage and ear surgery. Dr. Muguet was kind, professional, and my dog ​​isn't afraid of him (he's afraid of vets). Each time, whether by email or phone, he made himself available for my dog ​​and listened attentively.

Excellent veterinary clinic. I've been there twice, once for a vaccination and once for a check-up. My cat had an eye problem, and both times the vet who examined my cat was a true professional. You can immediately tell he loves animals with all his heart. He knows how to handle them and respects your pet. In the waiting room, cats are sometimes allowed to roam freely; they are very calm, and the receptionist gives treats to the dogs who come to see her.

In conclusion, it's a very good clinic from start to finish. I haven't seen all the vets, but if they're even half as good as the one I saw, that would be perfect.
Appointments were booked quite quickly, the vet and receptionist were very helpful, for me it was great 👍 …

Hello,
Thank you for your positive feedback and for your trust.
Knowing that our efforts to provide your pet with the best possible care are appreciated motivates us every day.
Our team remains at your disposal to provide quality care and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team
Always very well received by the team and the vets who are super nice to Sirop and very attentive to his condition at each appointment.
All the vets are attentive, understanding, and very competent. They always take the time to reassure my dog ​​before starting treatment.

Following your response, I am writing to inform you that I also do not tolerate being singled out by your veterinary assistant. As a retired professor, it is not in my nature to be disrespectful! I expect the same in return: respectful and professional behavior from this person.

You know how to twist situations to the detriment of clients!
How dare you speak of a "repeat offense"?
I would also like to point out that I had an appointment at 4:15 PM and my cat was seen at 4:45 PM. A 30-minute wait.

I will no longer have my animals treated at your clinic, where the reception is deplorable.

I have always had cats and have always had them well cared for. It will therefore be another veterinarian...

I have a complaint about the way one of the assistants treated me. When I arrived on time for my appointment with Zhevna, the cat I was worried about, the receptionist felt entitled to berate me and make very unpleasant remarks. All I did was ask if I needed to announce myself! This person was incredibly rude, verbally abusing me and commenting on my speech! All this in the waiting room. This person should really reconsider how they interact with clients who are concerned about their pets! I'm not the first person to complain! Will scheduling my next visit have to be stressful, wondering if I'll be treated this way, complete with a little moral lecture? In Mr. Devierne's time, this situation would never have happened; the receptionist at the time was quite remarkable. Thankfully, Dr. Muguet gave my Zhevna special attention and a caring approach, and everything went very well with great kindness. The doctor explained the source of her symptoms (sneezing) and the problem very clearly. Zhevna was well cared for!

So, should we rate the assistant or the reason we go to the vet? I mean, to get our pet treated! I chose what's best for my pet.
First appointment booked online. Confirmed by phone the day before. Consultation at the scheduled time. Helpful staff and friendly clientele. The patient had no complaints.

Excellent veterinary clinic.
Attentive professionals who provide excellent care for your pet.
Thank you to the team.

Excellent care was provided to my little dog.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

Hello,
We appreciate your feedback on our veterinary services.
This encourages us to continue in this direction and to offer the best possible care for your pet.

Please know that your pet's health and well-being will always be our top priorities.

Your veterinary team

Very competent and quick-responsive team, thank you for saving my little Toupie.

Hello,

Your veterinary team

Hello,
We have received your message and are sincerely sorry to hear of your dissatisfaction.
The health and well-being of your animals are our top priority, and we strive to provide each and every one of them with quality service.
We invite you to contact us by phone, email, or even directly at the clinic so that we can discuss the problems you have encountered.

Sincerely,
The Veterinary Team,

Friendly and highly competent team.
I recommend them.

Excellent veterinary practice.

The reception is always very friendly and welcoming.
The veterinarians are competent, caring, and very well-equipped.

Hello,
We are pleased to have been able to contribute positively to your pet's health. Your feedback encourages us to maintain this level of excellence.
We remain at your disposal should you have any questions or future veterinary needs.

Your Veterinary Team

The best 🫶 …

Hello,
Thank you so much for your positive feedback.
Our priority is the health of your precious companion, and we are delighted to see your satisfaction.
Your veterinary team
Competent team with a pleasant welcome.
Great team, responsive and offers good advice.

I am extremely disappointed and shocked by the way my 10-month-old miniature dachshund was treated. They suspected a foreign object in her nose, so they had to administer a sedative injection for further investigation. My dog ​​was terrified and screamed, trying to defend herself during the injection. I saw the vet become agitated, grab her roughly by the neck, and yell at her to calm her down. I intervened to take her back. Restraining animals in this way is outrageous and in no way professional conduct. The treatment was completed, and the nurses were kind, but I will never go back there.

I am deeply traumatized by my experience, and I am writing this review to warn other pet owners about Dr. Jacques Le Monnier.

I woke up one morning to find my dog ​​dead next to me in bed. She was cold and stiff. She passed away without my being able to say goodbye.

In the week leading up to her death, I went to the clinic twice: first because of a lump that had suddenly appeared on the back of her neck, and then again because her condition was deteriorating despite antibiotics.

On Friday evening, I was seen by Dr. Jacques Le Monnier. I repeatedly expressed my concern, as my dog's condition seemed serious. Yet, he assured me that her life was not in danger.

I felt unheard and condescending. No further tests were offered. As I left the appointment, I was told, "We'll see in a few days."

My dog ​​died the following night.

I share this opinion because I wouldn't wish this on anyone. If your pet shows worrying signs and you have any doubts, listen to your instincts and don't hesitate to seek a second opinion immediately.

Today, beyond the immense grief, I am left with a deep regret: not having been able to be with her properly in her final moments, or to say goodbye.

I've been living in Croix-Rousse for eight months now and I'm so glad I found this clinic! The team is incredibly friendly, there are two cats who greet you, and the interaction with the vets is fantastic! I highly recommend it!

By far my best experience at a vet's office.

First, I went in and sat down because some customers were buying treats and kibble, so I waited. The receptionist took the time to explain what was good for their pet.

When it was a dog's turn, the dog seemed to know her, and she gave him treats. The atmosphere was friendly and, above all, caring.

Then it was my turn to go in for my cat. I apologize, I don't remember the name of the vet who saw me, but he was undeniably an animal lover and acted with gentleness and delicacy, putting my cat at ease immediately. You can feel his kindness and love for animals right away, and the consultation went well, with the added bonus of learning how to get a cat into its carrier without any trouble.

My review is long, but to sum it up:

Perfect. Nothing to complain about.

Thank you so much for saving our cat!
So professional and took everything seriously.
We are forever grateful and a special thanks to Dr Jacques Le Monnier.

Clinique Vétérinaire Argos Lyon Croix Rousse has been incredible to us. We recently moved to Lyon from Sweden, and it felt a bit scary going to an unfamiliar clinic, but they welcomed us so warmly. Dr. Jacques Le Monnier took care of our sick cat and had the courage to make decisions that may have saved our little one’s life.

We are forever grateful for the help they gave us, and our beloved Milo is healthy again.

Hello,

Your Veterinary Team

The team (vets and assistants) is fantastic, always providing excellent advice and care.

They are sometimes overwhelmed, but always attentive and caring towards owners and animals, and especially available in case of emergency.

I highly recommend this clinic.

Furthermore, payment plans are available, which isn't often the case elsewhere...

Welcoming, professional, and caring.
The health and well-being of our two cats are the clinic's priority. Dr. Muguet is always attentive and offers excellent advice. I recommend them 100%.
Warm welcome, good advice. I will come back.
Very professional and attentive. We received excellent service for our two cats, and the medical care was top-notch. A special thank you to the fantastic veterinary assistants.

Our association was founded thanks to this clinic.

Without it, we would never have been able to save all our little charges.

A huge thank you to them for taking the time for us 💗🐾

Excellent welcome.
High-quality care.
Caring and competent staff.

Smiling, attentive, helpful, and available assistants.

The veterinarians are competent and kind to my three furry friends.

I highly recommend this clinic with its friendly and empathetic team.

Thank you for your support, your care, and your continued desire to help us improve the comfort and daily lives of our companions. 😻
Well done to you all!

Honestly, the reception was terrible. The assistants aren't professionals; all they care about is money. They can't even treat a timid cat like an aggressive one. I won't be recommending them anymore.
A team that is always available and attentive to our animals and their owners.

We remain at your disposal should you have any questions or future veterinary needs.

I've been to the clinic several times and was generally quite satisfied. The quality of the examinations varies considerably depending on the veterinarian. However, I was very disappointed during my last visit, as I paid over €200 for a blood test and related consultation. I was charged for two consultations, which is a bit absurd. It would have been nice to at least know about this beforehand. Because of this, I've switched veterinarians, as I find the billing process lacking in transparency.
Excellent welcome, lovely staff 😘 and very accommodating ✌🏼 I highly recommend this team for your small pets 🐾🐾 …

The vet took my dog ​​in for an X-ray of his limbs. I heard him howling on the other side of the wall, and no one offered to stop. I was shocked.

The result: X-rays that were barely interpretable, but I was charged for them. I changed vets.
An empathetic, fair and accommodating team, I recommend them a thousand times over!
A team that truly loves animals, very gentle and caring. In addition, they are very understanding and accommodating financially. I recommend this clinic without hesitation!

No real love for animals.
More like love for the owner's bank account.

Extremely disappointed.
My dog ​​was stapled without anesthesia... he was shaking all over from the pain.
I was struck off the register for two missed appointments. It was an absolute emergency on my end... This clinic is mercenary. The staff is very unfriendly.

If my little cat Dobby could write, he would undoubtedly give 5 stars too ⭐️

Thank you to this wonderful team: gentle, caring, and always available, even in emergencies! The veterinarians take the time to explain, reassure (us), and pamper our companions as if they were their own.

In short, here they take care of the animals… and the owners too. Thank you to the whole team for your professionalism and kindness.

Hello Ms. Mecking,

Thank you for your feedback. We are pleased that some members of our team were … More

We are now on the 3rd generation of cats (and also vets) treated by this clinic known as the Gros Caillou Veterinary Clinic, an excellent clinic which, despite its acquisition by the ARGOS group, has lost none of its seriousness, always providing quality care at a reasonable price considering the neighborhood.

A huge thank you. My little Couine was treated here for six years. Saved by the veterinary team, she received close, gentle, and caring care. I can't thank Dr. Berne and Dr. Muguet enough for all the care and time they dedicated to her. …

I highly recommend them. My cat is very nervous by nature, but he was welcomed and treated with kindness and great patience. The entire medical and reception team is efficient and welcoming. A big thank you for your services!

I brought my dog ​​in on the morning of January 2nd, when she was in a lot of pain. They were incredible. They rearranged their entire schedule to operate on her that afternoon, even though they could have sent me to the emergency room and …

A financial disaster since the Argos takeover! Prices have skyrocketed, and the quality isn't always there. Even the consultation fee for routine checkups like vaccinations has increased by at least 25%! …

I went to this clinic to have my cat Salem neutered.

The team was truly wonderful and caring. They reassured me about the operation …
Excellent clinic. Perfect welcome, top-notch professionalism. I highly recommend this clinic, which has the merit of seeing patients promptly and listening to their needs. The best in the Lyon area.
